feature_descriptions.greater flesh bond: The necros' bond with the corpse puppet improves, granting the advanced benefits described by Greater Flesh Bond.
feature_descriptions.see in darkness: At 12th level, the necros can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including magical darkness.
feature_descriptions.improved necrotic shield: At 13th level, Necrotic Shield grants twice the normal temporary hit points.

resources.name: Channel Negative Energy
resources.description: Daily uses equal 3 + casting ability modifier. The save uses the selected casting ability instead of Charisma.

resources.name: Channel Energy Dice
resources.description: Number of d6s rolled when channeling negative energy.

resources.name: Necrotic Shield Temporary HP
resources.description: Temporary HP granted to a fleshcrafted undead: level + casting modifier, doubled from level 13. Spend channel energy within 60 feet to restore them.

resources.name: Decaying Form Stage
resources.description: Tracks the cumulative undead-like stage gained at levels 4, 8, 12, and 16.

choice_providers.label: Casting and Practitioner Ability
choice_providers.description: Choose Intelligence or Charisma permanently at 1st level.

choice_providers.label: Fleshcrafts
choice_providers.description: Choose one Fleshcraft at levels 3, 7, 11, 15, and 19. From level 7, one undead may carry one advanced fleshcraft instead of a normal selection.

notes: Corpse Puppet uses the shared bonded-companion page and progression. The selected casting ability drives spell points, channel energy, and blended training.
